description: MCP server for RouteVerdict — x402 endpoint trust checks ($0.05 USDC on Base)
name: io.github.QuincyGB/route-verdict-mcp

environmentVariables.description: EVM private key (0x...) of a wallet holding USDC on Base. Used locally to sign the x402 EIP-3009 authorization. For paid calls.
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing that key (alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY).
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Spend guard per call in USDC micro-units (default 50000 = $0.05, the known price). The client refuses to sign anything priced above it.
environmentVariables.name: ROUTE_VERDICT_MAX_AMOUNT_UNITS

title: RouteVerdict
